title: Vaccines and Autism: A Measured Response
summary: hbomberguy's long video dissects the anti-vaccine movement, analyzing Andrew Wakefield's fraudulent MMR-autism study, the media's role and Wakefield's loss of his license. It combines detailed research with humor.
why: HN commenters call it the definitive, thorough answer to whether vaccines cause autism and recommend it as an entertaining deep dive.

quote.text: His documentary on Andrew Wakefield has become my definitive answer to people who ask me if the MMR vaccine causes autism
